recipes.oracle_text: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {2}.

recipe_coverage: Complete source identity and Oracle text are pinned. Actual parent and response casts use stack1/stack2 and normal legality, payment and selection for both controllers. Tests cover printed fixed or derived taxes, pay/decline/exact/unaffordable decisions, source costs and missing resources, typed targets, own/opposing spells, selected/unselected permanents, exact zone multiplicities and ordered libraries, and snapshot replay as applicable.  Countered response sources, lost targets, replacement/prevention, simultaneous responses and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
